author: Good Enough
description:
If a hyena attacks you, the wrong reaction could put you in even more danger.

Hyenas are powerful predators with incredibly strong jaws and aggressive pack behavior, making them one of the most dangerous animals in Africa. This video explains what to do during a hyena attack, the mistakes that can make the situation worse, and how to improve your chances of surviving the encounter.

This Short breaks down survival tips for one of the most intimidating predator encounters in the wild.
title: If a Hyena Attacks You, Do This 🦴😲 #wildlife #survival #animals #facts
